problem: University students struggle to find compatible peers for collaborative study sessions, leading to inefficient learning and missed networking opportunities.
target_user: University students seeking to form study groups with peers who share the same courses, compatible schedules, and preferred study styles.
goals: Enable students to register and verify their university identity
Allow students to build a profile with courses, availability, and study style preferences
Automatically suggest compatible study groups based on profile data
Facilitate group creation, joining, and communication without paid third‑party services
Provide a responsive web interface that works on desktop and mobile browsers
non_goals: Providing tutoring or content creation services
Integrating paid APIs or external messaging platforms
Handling payment processing or premium features
requirements: User registration and email verification using university domains
Profile management for courses, weekly availability slots, and study style (e.g., silent, discussion, mixed)
Matching algorithm that considers course overlap, overlapping availability, and study style compatibility
Ability to create, join, and leave study groups
In‑app group chat with basic text messaging
Scheduling tool for proposing and confirming study session times
Responsive UI built with open‑source libraries only
Data stored securely in a relational database
No reliance on paid third‑party services

user_stories.i_want: to create an account using my university email address
user_stories.so_that: my identity can be verified and I can securely access the platform
acceptance_criteria: Registration form accepts only email addresses ending with the university domain
A verification email containing a unique link is sent after sign‑up
Clicking the verification link activates the account
User can log in with email and password after verification
Password must be at least 8 characters with mixed case and a number

user_stories.i_want: to complete a profile with my current courses, weekly availability, and preferred study style
user_stories.so_that: the system can match me with suitable peers
acceptance_criteria: Profile page allows selection of multiple courses from a searchable list
User can input availability in 30‑minute blocks for each weekday
Study style options include Silent, Discussion, Mixed, and can be multi‑selected
All entered data is saved and can be edited later
Profile data is stored securely and linked to the user account

user_stories.i_want: to see a list of suggested study groups that match my profile
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly find peers to study with
acceptance_criteria: System runs a matching algorithm daily and updates suggestions
Each suggestion shows group name, shared courses, overlapping availability, and study style summary
User can filter suggestions by course or day of week
Suggested groups are limited to those with at least two other members meeting the criteria

user_stories.i_want: to request to join a suggested study group
user_stories.so_that: I can become part of an existing collaboration
acceptance_criteria: Each suggestion includes a ‘Join’ button
Clicking ‘Join’ adds the user to the group pending approval by the group owner
Group owner receives an in‑app notification of the request
User receives confirmation when the request is accepted or rejected

user_stories.i_want: to communicate with other members via an in‑app chat
user_stories.so_that: we can coordinate study sessions and share resources
acceptance_criteria: Group page includes a chat window showing messages in chronological order
Messages are sent and displayed in real time without page reload
Chat history persists for the lifetime of the group
Basic features: send text, view timestamps, and see sender name

user_stories.i_want: to propose and confirm a study session time that fits everyone’s availability
acceptance_criteria: Group members can propose a date and time slot within the next two weeks
All members receive a notification of the proposal
Members can accept or decline the proposal
When a majority accepts, the session is marked as confirmed and appears on each member’s personal schedule

user_stories.i_want: an admin dashboard that shows key usage metrics
user_stories.so_that: I can monitor adoption and identify issues early
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays number of registered users, active groups, and messages per day
Charts are updated daily without manual refresh
Access to the dashboard is restricted to admin accounts

user_stories.i_want: the web app to work well on both desktop and mobile browsers
user_stories.so_that: I can use it on any device without installing an app
acceptance_criteria: Layout adapts to screen widths from 320px to 1920px
All interactive elements remain usable on touch screens
Performance metrics (load time < 2 s) are met on typical campus Wi‑Fi
All core user flows (registration, profile creation, matching, group joining, chat, scheduling) are functional and pass automated integration tests
No paid third‑party services or APIs are used; all functionality relies on open‑source libraries and self‑hosted components
The application complies with basic data‑privacy principles: user data is stored encrypted at rest and transmitted over HTTPS
The system can handle at least 200 concurrent users without performance degradation
The product is delivered within the five‑week timeline by a team of four developers

risks.description: Limited five‑week schedule may compress development and testing phases
Matching algorithm complexity could exceed initial estimates
University email verification may require coordination with campus IT services
Data privacy compliance without paid security services
Team of four may face skill gaps in full‑stack development and UI design
